verdict.rationale: Gitea is documented as a self-hosted Git service, and users report deploying it as a Git server whose contributors clone from it, so basic Git hosting is clearly implied. The pack never explicitly documents clone, pull, or push over HTTPS or SSH, or compatibility with standard Git clients. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of HTTPS and SSH Git transport, confirmation that standard Git clients work for clone/pull/push, and hands-on corroboration of push and pull workflows.

support.subject: As a developer, I can clone, pull, and push repositories with any standard Git client over HTTPS or SSH

citations.quote: Free, self-hosted Git service under the MIT license.
This makes it convenient for individual developers or small teams to set up and manage their own Git services.
